name: Resume Verifier
description: Routes Resume Verifier Slack button clicks to the verifier service and gives the agent verdict, recheck and explain tools.

token.label: Internal token
token.help: Same value as INTERNAL_TOKEN in the verifier service.

slackActions.label: Slack button routing
slackActions.help: plugin = interactive handler (default); agent = press_button tool fallback; off = no button routing.

verifierUrl.description: Base URL of the verifier service (internal API).

token.description: INTERNAL_TOKEN, sent as the X-Verifier-Token header. Falls back to the INTERNAL_TOKEN environment variable.

slackActions.description: How Slack button clicks reach the verifier. Falls back to the SLACK_ACTIONS environment variable, then plugin.

toolTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the agent tool calls (verdict, recheck, explain).
